title: Acceleration (ত্বরণ)
placement: Book pages 43–44, topic 2.6: ত্বরণ (Acceleration). Next to the section text and চিত্র ২.০৬ (velocity–time graph), or in place of that graph.
description: Acceleration (ত্বরণ, pages 43–44, 2.6) with a CNG auto-rickshaw on a Bangladeshi road. On the straight road (সোজা রাস্তা) the student drives it with two pedals in the panel, press and hold: গতি বাড়াও (+2 ms⁻²) and ব্রেক করো (−2 ms⁻²); nothing pressed keeps the speed. Over the CNG the blue বেগ arrow grows and shrinks and the ত্বরণ arrow points forwards (ধনাত্মক ত্বরণ, purple), backwards (মন্দন, orange) or is gone (ত্বরণ নেই); the panel reads the speed in m/s. The panel draws the বেগ–সময় graph as it goes (its time axis growing 0–10, 0–20, 0–30 s), each piece lettered A, B, C… and coloured by its kind, so the student makes the book's চিত্র ২.০৬ themselves, and works out a = (v − u) ÷ t live for the piece being driven, or for a piece touched on the graph, under the book's sentence ত্বরণ হচ্ছে সময়ের সাথে বেগের পরিবর্তনের হার। On the bend (বাঁক) the same CNG goes at a steady 2.5 m/s on open sand and the student turns it with বাঁয়ে and ডানে on a 3 m circle: the speed stays put, but the বেগ arrow (and a compass in the panel) turns, and while it turns the circle and its middle are drawn and a ত্বরণ arrow points at that middle. Real size and real time. Test: 5 tap questions (which piece of a book-style graph is মন্দন / ত্বরণ নেই / ধনাত্মক ত্বরণ; a from u, v, t when speeding up or braking, with its unit and sign; the acceleration of a CNG at a steady speed; which of two CNGs from rest has the bigger acceleration, or both the same; whether turning at a steady speed is acceleration). Phone-first, Bangla. GLB: the CNG auto-rickshaw at real size, in metres.
